record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: Describe an open subset of an irreducible component of Hilb_d(A^3) other than the smoothable component; the paper allows d to be large, even much larger than 78.

evidence.quote: Problem VII. Describe (an open subset of) a component of Hilbd(A^3) other than the smoothable one. Here d can be a large integer, even d >> 78.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, and let $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ denote the Hilbert scheme parametrizing zero-dimensional closed subschemes of length $d$ in the affine space $\mathbb{A}^3_k$. The smoothable component of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ is the closure of the locus of $d$ distinct reduced points; it is known that $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ is reducible for $d \geq 78$ (so other irreducible components exist).\n\nProblem. For some integer $d$ (allowed to be large, in particular $d \gg 78$), exhibit an irreducible component $Z$ of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ different from the smoothable component, and describe an explicit non-empty open subset $U \subseteq Z$ by giving, for each point of $U$, an explicit presentation (e.g.\ by generators of the corresponding ideal $I \subset k[x,y,z]$ or by an explicit local algebra $k[x,y,z]/I$) of the length-$d$ subscheme it parametrizes.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of explicitly describing non-smoothable components of the Hilbert scheme of points on $\mathbb{A}^3$ remains an active research area. While elementary (non-smoothable) components have been constructed in various degrees and recent works (e.g., Jelisiejew, Szachniewicz, and others, 2022–2025) produce new families and even irrational such components, an explicit description of an open subset of a non-smoothable component of $\mathrm{Hilb}_d(\mathbb{A}^3)$ for large $d$ in the spirit requested appears to remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: Elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points (Jelisiejew)
status_evidence.snippet: Describes elementary components and constructions of non-smoothable components.
status_evidence.claim: Constructions of non-smoothable (elementary) components exist, but a general explicit description for large d on A^3 is not provided.

status_evidence.title: New elementary components of the Gorenstein locus of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2022) construction of new elementary components.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues to produce new non-smoothable components.

status_evidence.title: Irrational components of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of irrational components of Hilb_d(A^n).
status_evidence.claim: Non-smoothable components can be very complicated (even irrational), suggesting explicit description in A^3 is hard and open.
